headline: A 2018 law renames a Kansas flood control project after former county official M.S. "Mitch" Mitchell.
what_it_does: The law gives the Wichita-Valley Center Flood Control Project in Sedgwick County, Kansas, a new official name: the "M.S. 'Mitch' Mitchell Floodway." It is a naming change only. The summary does not describe any change to how the project is built, run, funded, or maintained.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the renaming took effect on that date.
